topic: Polaris systematic excess (c7 verification of ISS-2909 tldr_verdict patch)
our_argument_summary: WIN-065 is Refuted by Data. Three centuries of pole-star astrometry establish Polaris's ~0.66° offset from true celestial pole (epoch 2026.0); the dome's claimed +0.27° 'systematic excess' at 35.9°N is within Polaris's known diurnal-circle envelope. The dome's own coordinate table contradicts PRED-NEW-001 (Oslo Polaris elevation 59.90° vs WGS84 59.91°N — essentially zero excess; 22 of 24 cities match WGS84 to ±0.05°). PRED-NEW-001 registered 2026-03-12 post-dates the standard observations it 'predicts' — retrodiction, not prospective. Dome's own site lists the broader 'Polaris altitude matches latitude' prediction as FALSIFIED 2026-03-15, making simultaneous claim/refutation incoherent. n(r)-refraction structural dilemma (Section 1.8) blocks the high-latitude escape clause.
